'''Citlik IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Citlik sector/Legends|Citlik sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
[[Dirk Harkness]] got a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] on the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Introductory Adventure Game" />

==Appearances==
